verses.1: And after forty years, Solomon finished building the Temple of God and his own house.
verses.2: And the cities that Hurram gave to Shlomo, Shlomo built them. He also settled the children of Israel there.
verses.3: And Solomon went to Hama Tzova, and he strengthened it.
verses.4: And he built the city on the coast, and all the cities in the region that he had conquered.
verses.5: And he built the upper house of Horon, and also the lower house of Horon. He also built the cities of Matsor Homa, with their gates and walls.
verses.6: And all the cities of the enemies that belonged to Solomon, and all the cities of the chariots, and the cities of the soldiers, and all the places where Solomon had built his buildings in Jerusalem, in Lebanon, and throughout his kingdom.
verses.7: All the nations that are not from Israel: the Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivvites, and Jebusites.
verses.8: From their descendants who followed them in the land that they did not possess, among the children of Israel. Solomon lived to this very day.
verses.9: And from the children of Israel, those who were not given Shalom as slaves to serve him. For they were men of war, officers of their leaders, and those who rode in chariots.
verses.10: And these are the officers who serve King Solomon: fifty in number, all of them men.
verses.11: And Pharaoh’s daughter was taken up by Solomon from the city of David, to the house that he had built for her. For Solomon said, “No woman shall dwell in my house among the people of Israel, because those who live there are holy places where Jehovah dwells.”
verses.12: Then Shlomo built an altar to Yahweh on the site of the altar that had been built before.
verses.13: And on the day of Shabbat, according to Moses’ commandment, there are six occasions when Shabbat is observed: during the festivals of Sukkot, and also on the other days mentioned in the Torah.
verses.14: And he established the rules set by David, his father, regarding the priests’ duties and their responsibilities. He also determined how they should serve God and how they should act in front of the priests on that day. This was according to David’s commandment, the man of God.
verses.15: And they did not break the king’s commands regarding the priests and the Levites, in all matters related to their possessions.
verses.16: And from Solomon’s time until today, the House of God has been established, and everything related to it has been completed.
verses.17: Then Solomon went to Eciyon-Gevor and to Eliloth, on the shore of the sea, in the land of Edom.
verses.18: And he sent Hurm to his servants, along with ships and sailors who knew the sea. They went with Solomon’s servants and Ophir. From there, they took four thousand pieces of gold and fifty talents of silver. They brought these treasures back to King Solomon.
